svg.title: exhibition_stadium schematic
svg.text: exhibition_stadium · National Gate Skills Exhibition, Seoul World Cup Stadium (ch47–61)
Schematic plan in metres (pitch to scale, stands simplified), local frame: page-up is NOT north. Seoul World Cup Stadium is a real venue in Seongsan-dong, Mapo-gu;
the exhibition and every installation drawn here are fictional. Pitch 105 × 68 m (standard size, assumed). No key or script yet: decided here from the beats.
crew staging on the track: benches, Haein's tech table, Sejin's med kit
1 Obstacle course, 60 × 36 m on the pitch: the standardised timed event
(ch50–51, Doyun) and the adaptive obstacle bracket (ch53–58). Modular
2 The LEFT WALL of the final (ch57: "NIB. LEFT WALL. TAKE THE HIT."; ch58).
3 Operator boxes: raised glass booths OUTSIDE the course on the main-stand
side. Taeo sits in one while his crew runs the course (ch51: BangBang's
4 Archery range at end A: Sera's solo archery showcase (ch49 deal, ch55).
5 Sunline's aerial record rig at end B (ch50 prep, ch55 record).
6 Stage + big screen at end B: the award ceremony and the mic (ch59, ch61);
7 Press pit in front of the stage.
8 Lighting rig over the press pit: it drops in ch60; the reservoir cushions
a cameraman's fall through Orrin, and the device saturates and breaks.
9 VIP box in the main stand: Baek watches the semi-final (ch54).
10 BangBang's fan block, lower tier of the opposite stand: the chant (ch57,
51: behind Taeo in the operator box, through the glass to the course. 57:
from the course toward the chanting block. 58: high wide over the final. 60:
from the stage side as the rig falls toward the pit.
• The course is always seen from outside by Taeo: he never runs it ("his
• Real venue, fictional event: no real sponsor, team or stadium signage; all
screens and boards are blank shapes for the letterer.
• ch48–49 (written exam, practical) happen at noryangjin_exam, not here.
